notes.title: Augmented Empire Is Out Now on PC – 15% Off for a Limited Time
notes.content:
[b][h2]Citizens of New Savannah, your time has come.[/h2][/b]

The wait is over - Augmented Empire is officially out now on PC!

🎉 Get it now with a 15% launch discount for a limited time! 🎉

Step into the shadows of a city divided by class, corruption, and control. Originally acclaimed in VR, this enhanced PC edition brings the full tactical RPG experience to your screen - featuring a gripping cyberpunk story, rich turn-based strategy, and an unforgettable All-Star cast including Kate Mulgrew, Nick Frost, and Garrick Hagon.

From your hidden command centre, you'll lead a ragtag team of misfits across 26 missions, navigating danger, betrayal, and resistance as you fight to bring down the elite. With intuitive controls, additional accessibility options, and full controller support, this definitive version of Augmented Empire has been reimagined for both new recruits and returning veterans.

[b]Ready to rise up?[/b] Play now and reclaim New Savannah—
[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2856600/Augmented_Empire/]Visit the Store Page[/url]

Make surer to catch our launch stream on the store page to see the game in action!

Thank you so much for your support - and remember, every empire falls eventually...

The Augmented Empire Team

notes.title: Watch the Gameplay Stream of Augmented Empire - Out Now!
notes.content:
[b][h2]Augmented Empire has officially launched on PC, and the revolution begins now![/h2][/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45453806/2fff77d87407249b124ad11bac6917c987c97329.gif[/img]

Check out our gameplay stream right now over on our Steam store page! We’re showing off the game and (hopefully) providing a proper look at what to expect from this tactical cyberpunk adventure.

Set in the divided city of New Savannah, 2058, Augmented Empire blends turn-based strategy with a gripping dystopian narrative. Lead a crew of misfits, battle across 26 handcrafted missions, and take on a corrupt elite from the shadows of your hidden hideout.

This enhanced PC edition includes full controller support, plus an All-Star cast featuring Kate Mulgrew, Nick Frost, and Garrick Hagon.

Watch the stream now on our [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2856600/Augmented_Empire/]store page[/url]

Thanks for your support - and welcome to New Savannah.

The Augmented Empire Team

notes.title: Augmented Empire DEMO – Your Cyberpunk Revolution Begins!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45453806/2fff77d87407249b124ad11bac6917c987c97329.gif[/img]

[h1]Attention, Citizens of New Savannah![/h1]

We're thrilled to announce that the demo for Augmented Empire is now live as part of Steam Next Fest! Step into the divided city of New Savannah, 2058, and experience a taste of our dystopian cyberpunk uprising.

Announced last week, our acclaimed title - featuring an engaging narrative, tactical turn-based battles, and an All-Star Cast including Kate Mulgrew, Nick Frost, and Garrick Hagon - is ready to ignite your rebellion on PC. Lead your team of misfits and outlaws as you navigate a city torn apart by class divisions and corruption. With full controller support and additional accessibility improvements, the revolution has never been more inclusive.

Head over to our Store Page to check out the demo and dive into the world of Augmented Empire. We can't wait to see how you rise against the corrupt elite and reclaim New Savannah!

Stay tuned for more updates, and as always, thank you for your support, friends! 

Coatsink and The Augmented Empire Team
